06800067-e591-4e6b-a2b3-718b80d6a831,Project Controller,"Tallinn, Estonia",,Finance,hybrid,2026-09-23,https://careers.milrem.com/jobs/8438240-project-controller,"Milrem Robotics is looking for a Project Controller to strengthen our project management capability and support the successful delivery of increasingly complex projects.

In this newly created role, you will act as a financial partner to Project and Program Managers, helping us build transparent, reliable, and standardized ways to understand project performance. You will work closely with both our Finance team and Project Support Office, combining hands-on project controlling with the development of better processes, reporting and tools.
Your goal is to make sure we have the right information at the right time to identify deviations and risks early and make informed project decisions.
YOUR DAILY CHALLENGES WILL INCLUDE:
- Partnering with Project and Program Managers on project budgets, forecasts and financial performance
- Maintaining project financial baselines and analyzing deviations in cost, revenue, margin and cash flow
- Identifying project financial risks and assessing the financial impact of changes, while providing clear insights and recommendations
- Developing standardized project financial reporting, KPIs and portfolio-level visibility
- Improving project controlling processes, templates and forecasting practices
- Working with Finance, project teams and IT/Data stakeholders to improve data quality, dashboards and automation.
WHAT WE EXPECT:
- 5+ years of relevant experience in project controlling, financial controlling, management accounting, financial analysis, audit or a similar role
- Strong knowledge of budgeting, forecasting, cost management and financial analysis
- Good understanding of accounting fundamentals and how financial data flows through an organization
- Experience working with complex projects, preferably in an engineering, manufacturing, energy, infrastructure or other project-based environment
- Strong Excel and ERP systems skills
column2: experience with Power BI or similar tools is an advantage

column1: - Excellent analytical skills and a systematic approach to working with data
- A proactive and hands-on approach – you are comfortable diving into details, identifying issues and constructively challenging assumptions
- Strong collaboration and communication skills
- Excellent English.
WHAT WE OFFER:
- A chance to build and shape a new role and project controlling capability from the ground up
- An opportunity to work with complex international projects in the defense robotics industry
- Make a real impact by working with a dedicated, innovative team on technology that matters.
- Professional development opportunities in a fast-growing international technology company.
NB! This role is based in Estonia and we are not offering relocation.
To apply, please send your application by 07.10.26 at the latest. We review applications continuously and may contact qualified candidates for interviews before the official deadline."

0d5424e7-37c4-4989-88c7-388cae7ab122,Senior Technical Lead,"Best, Netherlands",,Systems Integrations,none,2026-07-31,https://careers.milrem.com/jobs/8156644-senior-technical-lead,"Some engineering roles focus on building products.
This one is about building solutions.
Every customer has different operational challenges to solve, and no two projects are ever the same.
One project might involve integrating specialist radar systems onto a THeMIS platform. The next could require combining existing Milrem technologies with entirely new third-party capabilities.
As our Senior Technical Lead, you'll turn customer commitments into engineering reality.

Working alongside Solution Architects, Project Managers and engineering teams across the business, you'll own the technical delivery of complex customer integrations—from early technical proposals through to successful delivery.
This is not a people management role.
You'll lead through technical expertise, systems thinking and influence.
You'll love it here if you:
- thrive in multidisciplinary engineering environments
- enjoy solving a different engineering challenge every few months
- connect software, electronics, mechanics and systems engineering into one coherent solution
- bring people together around complex technical challenges.
Who we're looking for:

We're particularly interested in people who have built complex products in which software, electronics, and mechanics come together to create a complete system. Experience in defence is welcome but not essential
column2: we're equally interested in candidates from robotics, aerospace, automotive, industrial automation and other multidisciplinary engineering environments.

column1: The strongest candidates will have experience in one or more of the following areas:
- Systems Engineering
- Embedded Systems
- Robotics or Autonomous Systems
- Mechatronics
- Defence, Aerospace or Automotive
- Industrial Automation or Complex Machinery
- Complex hardware/software product development
- Technical leadership across multidisciplinary engineering teams
Whether you're currently a Technical Lead, Systems Architect, Integration Lead, Engineering Lead, or an experienced CTO looking to get closer to engineering again, we'd love to hear from you!
Why join us?
- Customer Integrations sits at the centre of some of Milrem's most technically challenging customer programmes.
- Unlike many technical leadership roles, your product changes every few months.

- One month you might be leading the technical delivery of a customer solution built around existing Milrem technologies. Next, you'll be bringing together new platforms, suppliers, and engineering teams to solve an entirely different operational challenge.

If you're a System Architect, Technical Lead or senior multidisciplinary engineer based in the Netherlands and looking for a role where you can take broader ownership of complete technical solutions, we'd love to hear from you.
Location: Best, North Brabant, the Netherlands
Languages: Fluent Dutch and English"
